Recorded at v4416. Before this file, vendor/jolt/ held the wasm-compat build and its LICENSE and
nothing that said where they came from.

EVIDENCE, stated rather than asserted:
  - LICENSE beside this file reads "Copyright (c) Jorrit Rouwe", and Jorrit Rouwe is JoltPhysics'
    author.
  - github.com/jrouwe/JoltPhysics.js is the ONLY GitHub URL anywhere in this directory. Not the
    most frequent -- the only one. (For contrast, the same scan over vendor/three returns 58 hits
    for KhronosGroup/glTF against 9 for mrdoob/three.js, which is why frequency is not the test.)

NOT ESTABLISHED HERE: the exact upstream tag or commit. The build predates this record and nothing
in the directory pins one, so this file does not invent one. A round that rebuilds the artifact
should write the tag in here at that point.
